question: What does the acronym RAG stand for in the context of large language models?

subquestions: In the context of large language models, what does the acronym RAG stand for?

args.query: RAG stands for Retrieval-Augmented Generation large language models acronym
retrieval augmented generation acronym RAG definition
RAG stands for Retrieval-Augmented Generation large language models acronym

observations.content:
[1] Retrieval-augmented generation - Wikipedia
    https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Retrieval-augmented_generation
    Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a technique that enables large language models (LLMs) to retrieve and incorporate new information from external data sources.

[2] What is Retrieval-Augmented Generation? Learn RAG Benefits & Uses
    https://www.pryon.com/landing/what-is-retrieval-augmented-generation
    Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is the process of improving the output of a large language model (LLM) by combining the strengths of retrieval systems with generative models.

[3] What is Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)? | Google Cloud
    https://cloud.google.com/use-cases/retrieval-augmented-generation
    RAG, which stands for Retrieval-Augmented Generation, is an AI framework that combines the strengths of traditional information retrieval systems (such as search and databases) with the capabilities of generative large language models (LLMs) .

[4] Gemini for Developers - RAG
    https://lilys.ai/en/notes/gemini-rag-20251112/gemini-for-developers-rag
    RAG, or Retrieval Augmented Generation, makes AI models like large language models smarter and more accurate by combining the model's own knowledge with information it finds from external sources.

[5] RAG Explained: How Retrieval-Augmented Generation Improves...
    https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/rag-explained-how-retrieval-augmented-generation-improves-shreeram-n-pkoec
    RAG stands for: Retrieval + Augmented + Generation. Step 5: Augmentation + Generation. The retrieved content is passed to the LLM, which generates an accurate response. Frameworks like LangChain make this pipeline easier to implement.

[1] Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
    https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.11401
    View a PDF of the paper titled Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks, by Patrick Lewis and 11 other authors.

[2] History of RAG: How AI Learned to Look Things Up (2026)
    https://www.taskade.com/blog/rag-retrieval-history
    Retrieval-augmented generation was named in a May 2020 paper by Patrick Lewis and 11 co-authors.The RAG paper, Lewis et al. Retriever and generator trained end to end; state of the art on 3 open QA tasks. Gave the pattern its name and its architecture.

[3] How RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) is Redefining SEO
    https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/how-rag-retrieval-augmented-generation-redefining-seo-crazygraph-tkqdc
    RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) was introduced in a 2020 research paper by Patrick Lewis and colleagues at Facebook AI Research (now Meta AI). It was built to solve one glaring problem with large language models: they hallucinate.

[4] Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): From Theory to LangChain...
    https://www.bulbapp.io/p/46eb00e7-c08e-447c-9bc6-283edae5e889/retrieval-augmented-generation-rag-from-theory-to-langchain-implementation
    Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is the concept to provide LLMs with additional information from an external knowledge source. This allows them to generate more accurate and contextual answers while reducing hallucinations.

[5] Inside Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) Issue... | Medium
    https://medium.com/@muskanrath30/inside-retrieval-augmented-generation-rag-issue-1-origin-and-the-engine-ca45d27c5d5b
    RAG-Sequence vs. RAG-Token (From the Original Paper). RAG-Sequence and RAG-Token are two powerful variants of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) that differ fundamentally in how they integrate retrieved documents during response generation.

args.query: retrieval augmented generation acronym RAG definition

observations.content:
[1] Retrieval-augmented generation - Wikipedia
    https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Retrieval-augmented_generation
    Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a technique that enables large language models (LLMs) to retrieve and incorporate new information from external data sources.

[2] What is Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)? | NVIDIA Glossary
    https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/glossary/retrieval-augmented-generation/
    Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is an AI technique where an external data source is connected to a large language model (LLM) to generate domain-specific or the most up-to-date responses in real time. How It Works.

[3] What is RAG? - Retrieval-Augmented Generation AI Explained - AWS
    https://aws.amazon.com/what-is/retrieval-augmented-generation/
    Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is the process of optimizing the output of a large language model, so it references an authoritative knowledge base outside of its training data sources before generating a response.

[4] What is retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)? - IBM Research
    https://research.ibm.com/blog/retrieval-augmented-generation-RAG
    Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is an AI framework for improving the quality of LLM-generated responses by grounding the model on external sources of knowledge to supplement the LLM’s internal representation of information.

[5] What is Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)? | Google Cloud
    https://cloud.google.com/use-cases/retrieval-augmented-generation
    Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) combines LLMs with external knowledge bases to improve their outputs.

steps.note: In the context of large language models, **RAG** stands for **Retrieval-Augmented Generation**. [S1]
